title: ch or tch at the End
rule: At the end of a word, look at the ONE letter right before the ch sound. A short vowel alone: tch, like match. A consonant or a vowel team: ch, like lunch and beach. A few words are exceptions: much, such, rich, which.
trickText: Look at the ONE letter right before the ch sound. Short vowel, all alone? Use t c h. Consonant or vowel team? Use just c h.
say: Today's case: t c h or c h. Here is the trick, like c k and k. Look at the ONE letter right before the ch sound. If it is a short vowel all alone, use t c h. If it is a consonant or a vowel team, use just c h.

activities.ruleStrip: Short vowel alone → tch  ·  Consonant or vowel team → ch  (exceptions: much, such, rich, which)
activities.instruction: Find the ONE letter before the ch sound. Then choose tch or ch.
